methodology: Semi-structured, anonymized discovery interviews with enterprise technical leads

paid_value_hypotheses.hypothesis: Private air-gapped agent operations with verifiable zero-network egress commands a premium over managed SaaS agents.
paid_value_hypotheses.key_finding: Security and compliance teams categorically reject SaaS agent offerings that transmit tool telemetry or raw context externally.

paid_value_hypotheses.hypothesis: ACID durable execution with deterministic replay and human approval survival is required for mission-critical write operations.
paid_value_hypotheses.key_finding: Runaway loops and duplicated external API mutations were cited as the primary reason agent prototypes failed to reach production.

paid_value_hypotheses.hypothesis: Transparent cost-per-success metering with hard budget caps enables corporate budget approval where variable token spend is blocked.
paid_value_hypotheses.key_finding: Finance and engineering leads require strict pre-execution budget reservations with zero overrun tolerance.

paid_value_hypotheses.hypothesis: Enterprise teams want a single universal multi-agent chat interface to replace all existing developer CLI tools.
paid_value_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Users insist on discrete, single-purpose automation recipes integrated into their existing git/CLI/monitoring workflows rather than an intrusive monolithic agent.

paid_value_hypotheses.hypothesis: Customers will pay for proprietary fine-tuned general LLM weights bundled directly with the agent orchestrator.
paid_value_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Organizations mandate bring-your-own-model (BYOM) via Ollama, vLLM, or self-hosted API keys to comply with data sovereignty rules.

pilot_organizations.focus_workflow: Audited transaction reconciliation and ledger settlement
Air-gapped medical record extraction with span citation
Automated incident triage with human approval remediation
Durable multi-cloud resource decommissioning under hard budget ceilings
